title: One written model; every schema and type below it is inferred or derived
subject: main
summary: The model is the only hand-written entity shape. Entity zod schemas are inferred (createSelectSchema/createInsertSchema); types exist only through z.infer. Inpu

adr.context: Three things called "schema" lived in three places with no binding: hand-written drizzle models, hand-written zod input schemas beside them (drizzle-zod absent from the repo), and hand-written wire interfaces in shared/. Three sources of truth drift independently, and a parallel hand-written shape is exactly where agents invent fields the model never corrects.
adr.decision: The model is the only hand-written entity shape. Entity zod schemas are inferred (createSelectSchema/createInsertSchema); types exist only through z.infer. Input schemas are derivations (pick/omit/extend + refinements) — the diff is the only authored part. Composed shapes take entity fields from the inferred schemas and declare only computed fields; composing services return satisfies the composed type. Wire schemas are zod in the slice's shared/ — web infers from the wire contract, never from entity schemas.
consequences: Drift becomes a compile error at every derivation and satisfies — the compiler is the contract checker; no codegen machinery.
**Contradicted by the code today:** every `.schemas.ts` in UOM is a from-scratch z.object; drizzle-zod appears nowhere; shared/types/*.ts are plain interfaces, not zod. To fix.
Membership and consent-record stop lacking schemas — every entity gets them by inference.
Lint rules become mechanical: a bare z.object over entity fields outside a derivation, or an interface duplicating a z.infer, is a violation.
